Google Fi Customer Service Experience  
  
My experience with Google Fi customer service has been extremely disappointing.  
When I first contacted Google Fi about my bill, I was told that I should simply pay the first bill and that the next bill would include the 50% promotional discount. I trusted what the representative told me and paid the bill.  
A month later, I checked my account and the discount was nowhere to be found. I contacted customer service again, and this time I was told, “Actually, sir, the promotion ended right before you started your service.”  
That didn't make sense to me because I could still see the promotion advertised online, showing 50% off for the first 12 months with a Google Pixel phone.

results.title: How to File a Complaint With Relay: Steps and Timeline | Relay Help Center
results.content:
## What counts as a complaint at Relay?

A complaint is any expression of dissatisfaction about a Relay financial service, made orally or in writing, that alleges financial loss, distress, or inconvenience. That includes concerns about how your account was opened or closed, card issues, fees, rates, servicing, or customer service interactions.

## How do I file a complaint with Relay?

Send an email to complaints@relayfi.com with the details of your issue. To make sure your complaint can be investigated quickly, follow these steps: [...] 1. Open a new email addressed to complaints@relayfi.com.
2. In the body, include four things: who you are, what happened, when it happened, and the outcome you are seeking.
3. Indicate the complaint category that best applies (see the next section).
4. Attach any supporting screenshots, statements, or documentation.
5. Send the email.

## Which complaint category should I choose?

Pick the category that most closely matches your issue. The categories help route your complaint to the right team:

 Customer service
 Account opening
 Account closing
 Fraud
 Debit card
 Rates or APY (Annual Percentage Yield)
 Account terms
 Fees
 Servicing
 Other

If none of the categories fit, choose "Other" and describe the issue in your own words.

## What happens after I submit a complaint? [...] You want to file about the Relay Visa® Credit Card specifically. Use complaints@relayfi.com and choose the "Debit card" category note if your issue is card-related, or "Other" if it is a Relay Visa® Credit Card matter. For a specific transaction, file a dispute using the related article below.
